questions.question: What is your favorite memory of me from when I was very small?
What was the most rebellious thing you did when you were my age?
Which of your own parents' traits do you see most in yourself?
What did you want to be 'when you grew up' when you were ten years old?
What's the hardest lesson life has taught you so far?
If you could go back and tell your 20-year-old self one thing, what would it be?
What is one thing you're proudest of, that most people don't know about?
What does 'success' mean to you now versus what it meant in your 20s?
Is there a question you've always wanted to ask me but never did?
What's the biggest difference between how you were raised and how you raised me?
When do you feel most appreciated by me?
What's a fear you had as a parent that you never told me about?
What is one dream you still have for your life?
What's one thing you hope will never change about our relationship?
If we could go on an adventure anywhere together, where would it be?
